description:
You are one of several planners at a logistics company choosing where to build a new regional warehouse. Each planner has surveyed different aspects of the candidate sites.

The options are:
- Site A (Dralynans Bellynva)
- Site B (Riwel Kewel)
- Site C (Ozdax Ithgar)
- Site D (Talbre Ozume)

Exactly one option is best overall. Which site should be chosen? Your notes are incomplete: other participants hold information you do not have.

  - Site A is already zoned for industrial use
  - Site A faces organised local opposition
  - Site A has direct highway access
  - Site A has a large local labour pool
  - Site A has a rail spur connection
  - Site A has permits that can be fast-tracked
  - Site A saw 8 weather-related road closures last year
Site B (Riwel Kewel):
  - Site B is in a low-crime area
  - Site B is close to a cargo airport
  - Site B has room for future expansion
